'''Witness School''' is the teaching surface of the MELEK ecosystem, published at witness.melek.salon. It is a structured course rather than a marketing site, covering how the chain works, how to run infrastructure on it, and how to build against it.

== Structure ==
* ''/learn'' — the chain explained from first principles, for readers who have never used one
* ''/run'' — running a witness node
* ''/mine'' and ''/pool'' — mining, and pool participation
* ''/wallet'' — keys, custody, and the capability of each key
* ''/tokens'' and ''/fees'' — the token layer and its costs
* ''/whitepaper'' — the whitepaper
* ''/academy'' — the structured course
* ''/hathor'' — the AI witness
* ''/servers'' and ''/build'' — infrastructure and building on the chain
* ''/dev/melek'', ''/dev/prana'', ''/dev/token'', ''/dev/contracts'', ''/dev/services'' — developer documentation

== Rationale ==
Witness seats in a delegated-proof-of-stake chain are filled by stake-weighted election. The quality of that governance depends on whether voters understand what a witness does. Witness School exists so that a seat can be sought, and a vote cast, by someone who understands the role.
